resources.string: Sign in to keep your lists in your account on a Usuals server, open them in the web app and share them with other people there.
On a computer signed in to the web app, choose Connect a phone and scan the code it shows.
Scan the QR from the web app
Allow the camera to scan the code, or sign in in the browser below instead.
Enter your server’s address and sign in in the browser on this phone.
Every list on this phone is saved to your account on this server and stays in sync with it.
The server no longer accepts this phone. Your lists are still here: sign in again to keep them in sync, or sign out to remove them from this phone.
Your lists stay in your account and are removed from this phone. You can keep using the app with a new list that stays on this phone.

resources.string: When you sign in, your lists, their history and the people you share them with are stored on your server, and whoever runs it can read them. Recipes and product lookups still come directly from your phone.
That is not a Usuals code.
This code comes from an older version. In the web app, choose Connect a phone again and scan the new code.
This phone is already signed in. Sign out first to use another account.
Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
This code has expired or was already used. Show a new one in the web app.
This server needs a newer version of Usuals.
The server did not accept the sign-in. Try again.
The list disappears from your phone and your account. Its owner can add you again.
No one else on this server matches.
Sharing works through an account on a Usuals server. Sign in under Account: your lists sync to your account, and you can share any of them with people on that server.
Could not reach the server. Try again.
Sign in again to change who has access.
This list already has as many people as it can hold.
The server did not accept that change.
The list and its history are removed for everyone who has it.
Every item on the list is removed, checked or not, for everyone who has it. Your purchase history stays.
The list is archived for everyone who has access to it. You can restore it from Archived in your lists.
The list is archived only for you. The others who have it keep it, and you can restore it from Archived in your lists.
Signed out by the server. Sign in again to sync.
Not synced yet. Changes are sent when the server can be reached.
Update Usuals to keep this list in sync.
The server refused a change: the list or the account is full.
